sources.title: laki35/MOSS-TTS-Nano-Small · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MOSS-TTS-Nano is an open-source multilingual tiny speech generation model from MOSI.AI and the OpenMOSS team. With only 0.1B parameters, it is designed for realtime speech generation, can run directly on CPU without a GPU, and keeps the deployment stack simple enough for local demos, web serving, and lightweight product integration.

sources.title: E2-TTS: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview E2-TTS is a fully non-autoregressive zero-shot text-to-speech model developed by SWivid that generates natural-sounding speech from text without requiring speaker-specific training data. The model operates through a non-autoregressive architecture that processes the entire output sequence in parallel, delivering significant speed improvements over traditional autoregressive TTS ...
